visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins at night on the top deck of an open-air red double-decker bus. A group of people are dancing energetically. A man in a black afro wig is prominently featured, while city buildings with glowing lights pass in the background. (2) A close-up shows a woman wearing a sparkly silver dress, a tiara, and a sash labeled 'Birthday Girl'. She holds a large green fanned-out accessory while her friends cheer around her. (3) Transition to a daytime shot on a city sidewalk. A man in a black afro wig and silver flared pants pulls a large orange cart loaded with black bags and a white cooler past leafy green trees and parked cars. (4) People are shown boarding the red bus during twilight. The bus has 'Taipei Sightseeing' written on its side. (5) Back to night, the scene is filled with flashing neon lights and rapid cuts of people in disco-themed outfits partying. A man in a checkered jacket holds up a smartphone to record the event. (6) Shots of iconic Taipei landmarks appear, including the brightly lit Taipei 101, the Presidential Office Building, and the Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall under the night sky. (7) A man and woman in sparkly outfits kiss on the bus deck with the glowing Taipei 101 tower positioned perfectly in the background. (8) The final scene shows the entire group of women in shimmering dresses standing on the street in front of the red bus, cheering and waving to the camera.
